setting: a cozy kid bedroom at night, the same room as in the attached room picture if one is attached: soft warm peach walls, wooden floor, a low wooden bed with a rounded headboard along the back wall on the left, seen from its long side, with a white pillow at the headboard and a smooth lavender blanket; a small warm glowing lamp on a little wooden shelf on the back wall; a window in the middle of the back wall showing a dark blue night sky with a crescent moon and a few stars; a round cream rug on the floor in front of the bed; a rounded light-wood door on the right wall. Props look the same in every picture: the toy box is a rounded wooden toy chest painted soft sky-blue with one yellow star on its front and a lid hinged at the back; the blocks are colorful wooden blocks (red, yellow, blue, green); the ball is a small ball with wide red and white stripes, like a little beach ball; the teddy bear is small, round and light brown with round ears and a peach tummy and muzzle. Few props, soft warm light, gentle shadows. The bottom-right corner of the picture is plain wooden floor with nothing important in it

reference.kit: first kit story: no picture per scene. kit/room.png is the one room of every scene; hero_a, hero_b, lulu_a and props are sheets cut into sprites (tool/sprite_sheet.py) and placed per scene by docs/stories/tidy_toys/stage.json (tool/stage.py). Only cover and sticker are normal pictures

pictures.cover: Night, crescent moon in the window. {hero} kneels on the round cream rug with both arms up, beaming. To the right of {hero}, on the floor just left of the door and well away from the bottom-right corner, stands the open sky-blue toy box with the yellow star, full of colorful wooden blocks with the red-and-white striped ball on top. The small round light-brown teddy bear with round ears and a peach tummy sits on the bed on the left. Lulu floats in the air above the rug, clapping her paws. {hero} and Lulu do not touch. The floor is clean and tidy. If a room picture or a props sheet is attached, the room, toy box, blocks, ball and teddy look exactly like in them
pictures.sticker: a closed rounded wooden toy chest painted soft sky-blue; on its front, a sleepy happy face (closed curved eyes, small smile) with one small yellow star above the face; a small round light-brown teddy bear with round ears, a peach tummy and muzzle and a little smile sitting on its lid

room.prompt: Edit the attached picture. Keep the same room, camera angle, framing, walls, window with the crescent moon, lamp on the little shelf, round cream rug, wooden floor, door, warm night lighting, colors and soft 3D art style. Remove the sleeping child, the small glowing bunny on the headboard together with its glow and sparkles on the wall, the teal suitcase with the red heart tag, the orange backpack with the yellow star and the straw hat with the pink ribbon, and fill those places with what is behind them (wall, floor, door, bed). Keep the bed in exactly the same place and size, headboard against the left wall, seen from its long side. The bed is now empty and neatly made: the lavender blanket lies smooth and flat over the whole mattress, the white pillow sits at the headboard on the left. Raise the bed a little on four short wooden legs, so that a clearly visible dark empty gap, about as tall as a small ball, runs under the whole front side of the bed between the bed frame and the floor. The floor on the right, in front of the door, is empty. Add nothing else: no toys, no people, no animals, no text.

props.note: The three toy chests are the very same chest at the same size and from the same angle (from the front, slightly from above); only the lid and what is inside change. No faces on the chests, blocks, ball or blanket; only the teddy has its own little face. Sizes compared with the chest: the ball is about one fifth of the chest's width; each block is about the size of the ball; the block pile is about as wide as the lying teddy and a little taller than it; the sitting teddy is about half as tall as the chest; the blanket mound is about twice as long as the chest is wide.
